fields.description:
## Context

Test creation calibration today has no signal for "did we add tests for new intent items?" Test-writing sub-agents can produce many tests that pass review but do not cover newly-introduced SC/DoD/AC entries — and the failure is invisible until production. Today there is no per-PR or per-epic metric that distinguishes "suite grew because behavior was added" from "suite grew due to test inflation." Users affected: DSO maintainer, sprint orchestrators, test-writing sub-agents, code-reviewer-test-quality, completion-verifier, and downstream calibration consumers (411b-a047 mutation infrastructure once brainstormed, 69e8-af39 feedback loop). After this epic ships, when a sprint agent closes a story that has an SC with no test_artifact registered in the manifest, the completion-verifier emits a non-empty "Intent Allocation Findings" section naming the uncovered SC — where today closure is silent.

This epic delivers the first version of suite-growth metrics: (a) manifest-claim breadth + (a+) header-vs-source import check, both implemented as deterministic scripts. Stronger signals (intent-anchored line coverage, manifest-claim depth) are deferred to fb3e-b01b at P4 until the simpler signals' real-world catch rate is known.

## Success Criteria

SC1: plugins/dso/docs/contracts/intent-coverage-findings.md published with a jsonschema. Seven finding types: intent_with_no_test, test_artifact_missing_on_disk, test_artifact_fails, header_source_mismatch, dynamic_import_inconclusive (fail-open, warn), source_files_unresolved (warn; both manifest entry's source_files field AND parent ticket file_impact absent/empty), file_impact_likely_stale (warn; source_files resolved from file_impact but referenced files don't exist on disk). Severities: warn (default), block (reserved for intent_with_no_test at closure-time only). contract_version=1. Each consumer validates incoming findings JSON against the published jsonschema before processing.

SC2: plugins/dso/scripts/intent-coverage-check.sh implements (a) — manifest-claim breadth. Reads the 94ed manifest via intent-allocation-read.sh. For each end-state intent_id: (i) entry presence in the merged manifest; (ii) test_artifact.path realpath() normalization THEN file existence on disk; (iii) test pass/fail. Pre-commit invocation runs ONLY steps (i)+(ii) — fast checks. Test-pass validation step (iii) runs in CI workflow OR at closure-time on ticket-transition — NOT on every commit, eliminating pre-commit latency. Findings written to file via `--output-file` flag (ARG_MAX-safe; not passed as command-line argument or env var). Exit codes: 0 = no findings; 1 = warn-only; 2 = at least one block-mode finding.

SC3: plugins/dso/scripts/intent-header-source-check.sh implements (a+) — header-vs-source import check. ONLY applies to test files that have an intent-claim header per d566-afa6 Rule 6; files without a header are skipped (header presence is d566's reviewer concern, not 7f42's). For each test file with a header: (i) extract intent_id; (ii) resolve source_files via manifest entry's source_files field if present → else parent ticket's file_impact array → else emit source_files_unresolved (warn, fail-open; skip check for that intent); when file_impact is used, additionally check disk presence of each referenced file and emit file_impact_likely_stale (warn) for missing entries; (iii) parse the test file with sg (ast-grep); when sg unavailable OR no parser for the test language, emit dynamic_import_inconclusive (warn, fail-open) — NO grep fallback (grep fallback produces false positives); (iv) emit header_source_mismatch when test file contains no reference to any source_files entry. Dynamic-import patterns detected for fail-open: Python importlib.import_module with variable arg; JavaScript eval/Function/dynamic require with computed string; Ruby send/public_send. Findings written via `--output-file` (ARG_MAX-safe).

SC4: Multi-surface consumption — three consumers, one published contract:
- (a) plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-intent-coverage-gate.sh invokes only the FAST checks (file existence + header parsing). NO test-runner invocation in pre-commit. Block-mode reserved for intent_with_no_test at closure-time only, detected via ticket-transition hook.
- (b) 94ed-f55c's manifest-aware default validator (already registered with a03c-d55e's pluggable end-state-item-validator hook) ingests the findings JSON. ALL seven finding types (intent_with_no_test, test_artifact_missing_on_disk, test_artifact_fails, header_source_mismatch, dynamic_import_inconclusive, source_files_unresolved, file_impact_likely_stale) are explicitly enumerated as a contract requirement for 94ed's validator output mapping — the validator must register each type for rendering in the completion-verifier "Intent Allocation Findings" section.
- (c) .github/workflows/intent-coverage.yml invokes both scripts AND the (a)-step-iii test-pass validation step at CI time. Posts findings as PR comment via upsert-by-marker pattern: finds prior bot comment by the stable marker `COVERAGE_FINDINGS_<epic-id>` and edits it in place; if absent, posts new. One comment per PR, never a thread. Fallback when comment-write is unavailable (e.g., fork PRs with read-only GITHUB_TOKEN): write findings to the GHA job summary so the signal is not silently dropped.

SC5: Multi-language synthetic end-to-end test covering nine fixture scenarios:
- (a) HAPPY PATH: Python + bash test fixtures with valid intent-claim headers and manifest entries pointing at them. Both scripts return zero findings.
- (b) INTENT_WITH_NO_TEST: fixture epic with 2 SCs, only one has a manifest entry. intent-coverage-check.sh surfaces intent_with_no_test for the uncovered SC. completion-verifier dispatch produces a non-empty "Intent Allocation Findings" section naming it.
- (c) HEADER_SOURCE_MISMATCH: fixture Python test + fixture bash test both with valid intent-claim headers but no source-file symbol references. intent-header-source-check.sh surfaces header_source_mismatch for each.
- (d) SOURCE_FILES_UNRESOLVED: intent_id whose manifest entry has no source_files field AND whose parent ticket file_impact is empty. intent-header-source-check.sh surfaces source_files_unresolved (warn, fail-open) and skips the (a+) check for that intent.
- (e) FILE_IMPACT_LIKELY_STALE: parent ticket file_impact references a path that doesn't exist on disk. intent-header-source-check.sh surfaces file_impact_likely_stale (warn) but still attempts source-symbol matching against the surviving file_impact entries.
- (f) DEFERRED_TEST OVERRIDE: manifest entry with deferred_test: true set. Closure attempt on the parent ticket does NOT block on intent_with_no_test for that intent.
- (g) MISSING_SG: simulate sg absence on the runtime PATH. intent-header-source-check.sh emits dynamic_import_inconclusive (warn) for all test files; NO grep fallback is executed; pre-commit does NOT block.
- (h) BACKWARD_COMPAT_94ED_LEGACY: manifest entry without source_files field AND without deferred_test field (pre-extension legacy schema). Scripts handle gracefully: source_files resolution falls back to parent ticket file_impact; absent deferred_test treated as false. Verifies the additive 94ed schema extension preserves backward compatibility for existing consumers.
- (i) MID_SPRINT_SC_ADDITION: fixture epic with 1 SC and 1 test_artifact registered passing; a 2nd SC is added to the epic description without registering a corresponding test_artifact. intent-coverage-check.sh surfaces intent_with_no_test for the new SC; completion-verifier dispatch produces non-empty "Intent Allocation Findings" section. Verifies the primary real-world miss pattern.

SC6: Dynamic-import fail-open verification per language. Python importlib.import_module with variable arg; JavaScript eval/Function/dynamic require with computed string; Ruby send/public_send. Each emits dynamic_import_inconclusive (warn); pre-commit does NOT block; completion-verifier surfaces as informational finding (not blocking closure).

## Approach

Four sequential phases, each independently mergeable:
- Phase 1: SC1 (findings jsonschema contract) + SC2 (intent-coverage-check.sh; manifest-claim breadth check).
- Phase 2: SC3 (intent-header-source-check.sh; header-vs-source via sg) + SC6 (dynamic-import fail-open pattern detection per language).
- Phase 3: SC4 (multi-surface wiring — fast-only pre-commit hook, 94ed validator finding-type mapping, CI workflow upsert-by-marker with GHA-summary fallback).
- Phase 4: SC5 (nine-scenario multi-language synthetic end-to-end test).

7f42's sg usage is internal to intent-header-source-check.sh; this epic does not introduce a shared AST contract. If a Polyglot Test Gate epic later requires polyglot AST traversal, it will own that capability independently. The two epics' sg invocations are not coupled.

## Scenario Analysis (Blue Team surviving)

- Stale file_impact arrays produce false-positive header_source_mismatch (high/correctness): partially mitigated by SC1's new file_impact_likely_stale finding type — staleness is surfaced as warn rather than masquerading as a genuine mismatch.
- Tautological import satisfies (a+) symbol-reference check despite zero behavioral catch power (high/correctness): accepted as known by-design residual; reserved for 411b-a047's mutation-kill verification.
- ARG_MAX exceeded for large epics' findings JSON (high/runtime): mitigated by SC2/SC3's --output-file flag — findings written to disk, not passed via shell arg or env var.
- CI findings comment on fork PRs triggers no-permission error (low/deployment): mitigated by SC4(c)'s GHA-summary fallback — signal survives even when comment-write is unavailable; documented as a known limitation pending fork-PR security work.

## Out of Scope

- Intent-anchored line coverage and manifest-claim depth metrics: deferred to fb3e-b01b at P4. Stronger signals require polyglot per-test line-coverage infrastructure (coverage.py + bashcov + istanbul/nyc) and per-test attribution storage; the ROI on those vs 411b-a047's mutation-kill is poor.
- Behavioral adequacy of imports: a test that imports a source module but doesn't actually exercise the SC behavior satisfies (a+). Reserved for 411b-a047's mutation-kill verification.
- Polyglot Test Gate AST traversal patterns: 7f42 does not introduce a shared sg invocation contract. Polyglot Test Gate (if pursued) owns its own AST traversal.
- Fork-PR-friendly findings posting: deferred to CI security work; SC4(c)'s GHA-summary fallback is the interim signal.

## Dependencies

- a03c-d55e (Closure Checks schema migration) — required. Findings reference end-state SC/DoD/AC items separated from Closure Checks by a03c's schema cleavage; surfaced via a03c's pluggable end-state-item-validator hook.
- 94ed-f55c (Plan-time intent allocation manifest) — required. SC2's check consumes the manifest via intent-allocation-read.sh; SC3's source_files resolution prefers the manifest entry's source_files field; SC4(b) hooks into 94ed's manifest-aware default validator.
- d566-afa6 (Generation-time prevention) — required. SC3 parses test-file intent-claim headers per d566-afa6 Rule 6.

### Coordination with 94ed-f55c

Additive 94ed manifest schema extension required:
- New optional field per manifest entry: `source_files: [array of source file paths]`. When present, used preferentially over parent ticket file_impact for SC3's source-symbol resolution.
- New optional field per manifest entry: `deferred_test: bool` (default false). When true, suppresses intent_with_no_test at closure-time block evaluation (SC2 step iii).

Both extensions are additive and non-breaking for forward-compat-preserving consumers (94ed's spec explicitly requires unknown-field passthrough). Coordination via ticket comment on 94ed-f55c-51f5-45f6 referencing this epic and the two new fields.

## Planning Intelligence Log

- Web research (Step 2): not triggered.
- Scenario analysis (Step 3): triggered (SCs >= 5); 15 red-team scenarios; 4 surviving after blue-team filter (all addressed via additional spec mitigations).
- Cross-epic scan (Step 2.25): 1 conflict (a03c hook coupling, intentional), 1 ambiguity (d566 Rule 6 dep, manageable), 5 considerations (94ed schema lock, 69e8 consumer, c13f, cf7b, Polyglot Test Gate [now explicitly descoped], CodeQL gates), 2 benign.
- Bot-psychologist (Step 5): not triggered — this epic ships deterministic check scripts and thin hook wiring with no new LLM-facing prompt or skill content.
- Fidelity review (Step 4): Agent Clarity (5, 5), Scope (4, 4, 4, 4), Value (4, 4). All dimensions >= 4 after one revision cycle.
- Scale context (Step 0): small — per-PR or per-epic metric computation; not a high-traffic system.
- Session-signal override for complexity routing: success_criteria_count = 6 (< 7 threshold); scenario_survivor_count = 4 (< 10 threshold) — would route per complexity-evaluator output; preplanning explicitly deferred this session.
- User-directed scope decisions during brainstorm: ship full (a) + full (a+); placeholder fb3e-b01b at P4 created for (b)+(c) deeper signals; deterministic-script implementation (no LLM dispatch in checks); 10% ambiguous cases fail open with warn.
